blocks.text: The marked draft of the first set of core messages for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} is on its way to you now, a little ahead of where I promised. As I mentioned, the lines that shift with the audience question are flagged in the margin, so you can go straight to the two or three that will matter most.

I have left room in the wording for what John Macias hears in the interviews, so please read it as a working draft and not a finished one. If anything reads false to how your leadership actually speaks, mark it freely; that is the most useful thing you can send back.

For our record, final sign-off stays with you, Jennifer Herrera. Send it over with your notes whenever it suits, and I will turn them the same day so the Suarez-Jones messaging is ready before the interviews begin.
